One board catalog, like the embed catalog

Today each layer keeps its own list: the loader's allowlist in boardLoad.ts, the limits in boardData.ts, the tools in boardTools.ts and drawingBoard.ts, and the preview's renderers. A new kind means touching all of them, and missing one is how the highlighter load error happened. The proposal is one source, generated into each layer the same way pnpm gen:openapi -embeds does for notes.

Sourceserver/internal/boardcatalogEach kind: element or block, its fields and limits, which board may hold it (question, workspace), whether it reaches the marking image and the preview.

GIF search results can't be shown here without a KLIPY or GIPHY key; they look like any GIF site's grid of moving clips, with the service's credit under it.

Where emoji and GIFs could come from

Two kinds of source. An emoji set we ship with the app, served from our own storage, sends nothing anywhere. A GIF search service is reached from the student's browser, so the service sees their searches and IP, and a GIF on the canvas stays a link to that service: if it removes the GIF, it goes from the canvas too.

SourceKindLicence or termsNotes
Fluent Emoji (Microsoft)Emoji, staticMITAbout 1,500, in 3D, colour and flat styles. Brand emoji (Clippy, Xbox) are left out of the open release. The 3D style already looks like stickers.
Noto Animated Emoji (Google, picked)Emoji, animatedCC BY 4.0, creditLottie, WebP and GIF. A credit line on the picker covers it.
TwemojiEmoji, staticCC BY 4.0, creditFlat, well known; still maintained as a community fork.
OpenMojiEmoji, staticCC BY-SA 4.0ShareAlike: a changed emoji must carry the same licence.
Capy-drawnStickersOursThe capybara sketches are paused; a small set later.
KLIPY (picked)GIF, sticker, clip and meme searchFree: 100 calls an hour while testing, unlimited once approved; KLIPY brandingAds only if switched on for the key. Rating filters (profanity, violence, sexual content, substance use) set in its panel. Searches and GIFs must load from the student's browser straight from KLIPY, never copied or sent through our server without its written approval.
GIPHY (Meta)GIF and sticker searchFree beta key (100 calls an hour); production key costs a fee, price on applicationThe biggest library, with a G/PG rating filter. "Powered by GIPHY" credit; GIFs also load straight from GIPHY.
Tenor (Google)GIF searchAPI closed 30 June 2026The website and keyboards still work; apps can't use it.
UploadAny GIF or imageThe student's ownWorks today: an image block plays a GIF on the canvas.

Your picks

  1. Misc layout: A tiles, picked 9 Nov.
  2. Question board Charts: keep its own Charts slot as today, or a Misc there too holding only Charts. I'd keep the slot: a Misc with two items hides them for no gain.
  3. Emoji: Noto Animated Emoji, picked 9 Nov. The tile is called Emoji.
  4. GIFs: KLIPY search with ads off and the strictest filters, picked 9 Nov; upload still works.
  5. Catalog: build the generated board catalog before adding these kinds. Yes: the new kinds are exactly where the lists would drift apart.
